name: date-picker
useFor: Use for a date in a form or filter (a key's expiry, an order's date range). Use DateRangePicker for ranges; give presets for common choices (Today, Last 7 days). Give it a name for FormData; the value posts as YYYY-MM-DD.
constraints: A free-text date field without a picker
A picker that stays open after a single date is chosen
Presets that do not match the calendar's selection
source: Extrapolated from opencommerce (the select field and the floating panel)
title: Date Picker
description: The select's field with a calendar glyph, opening a calendar in the floating panel, with optional presets.
